title: Flexibility-Aware Clustering of Residential Electricity Consumption for Demand Response Targeting Using High-Resolution Smart Meter Data
description: Reproducible analysis code and derived outputs for flexibility-aware residential electricity consumption clustering and demand-response targeting using the PLEGMA dataset.
